title: Confirm Geek+ RMS Robot Control Screen Loads Before Master E-Stop Clear
summary: Use the live RMS / fleet status UI to sign in, open the monitor/robotControl screen, and confirm that it is available for viewing before the site or UPS coordinates removal of the physical master E-stop. This procedure does not authorize or perform the physical E-stop reset.
when_to_use: Use during an unplanned-restart situation when the site or UPS needs confirmation that the live RMS monitor/robotControl screen is available before removing the physical master E-stop.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to remove, reset, or otherwise operate the physical master E-stop.
Do not use this procedure as a substitute for site safety confirmation or physical-floor control.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Access the RMS / fleet status UI, confirm that the monitor/robotControl screen loads, and communicate the screen-availability result.
The site or UPS performs and coordinates any physical master E-stop removal; this procedure does not direct the physical action.

safety_notes: Do not remove or reset the physical master E-stop through the RMS / fleet status UI.
If the RMS robotControl screen is unavailable, do not communicate a successful screen-load check or proceed with the screen-availability confirmation.
access_or_tools_needed: Administrator-related RMS access indicated by the source; exact permissions and credentials are not specified

access_required: L2_support access to the live RMS / fleet status UI
Administrator-related RMS access as indicated by the source
system_preconditions: The RMS web UI is reachable before the master E-stop removal is coordinated.

visual_references.description: RMS / fleet status UI reference showing the unplanned-restart context, administrator-related access notation, instruction to confirm that the screen loads, and the monitor/robotControl path.

steps.title: Open the live RMS monitor/robotControl path
steps.purpose: Reach the live RMS / fleet status UI screen that must be checked before master E-stop removal is coordinated.
steps.instruction: On the live RMS / fleet status UI, open the displayed monitor/robotControl path: https://fortna-rms-primary.txrth.otnet.ups.com/static/rms/#/monitor/robotControl.
steps.expected_result: The RMS sign-in page or RMS monitor/robotControl entry point is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The live RMS / fleet status UI responds and presents the requested monitor/robotControl path.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS URL or monitor/robotControl entry point does not respond or cannot be reached.
stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS / fleet status UI or the monitor/robotControl path is unreachable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source displays the RMS monitor/robotControl path and instructs the user to log into RMS and confirm that the screen loads before UPS removes the master E-stop.

steps.title: Sign in to the live RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Authenticate to the RMS / fleet status UI so the robotControl screen can be checked.
steps.instruction: Sign in to the live RMS / fleet status UI using the available administrator-related access indicated by the source. Do not infer or create credentials or permissions that are not provided.
steps.expected_result: The RMS / fleet status UI accepts the available access and presents the authenticated RMS interface.
steps.healthy_condition: The authenticated RMS interface is available for navigation to monitor/robotControl.
steps.failure_condition: Authentication fails, the required access is unavailable, or the authenticated RMS interface cannot be reached.

actions.label: Sign in to RMS
actions.exact_action: Log into RMS using the available administrator-related access indicated for the screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: The required RMS access is unavailable or sign-in does not provide access to the RMS interface.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source displays the RMS access notation "C: admin +" and instructs the user to log into RMS.

steps.title: Confirm the RMS robotControl screen loads
steps.purpose: Verify that the live RMS robot-control view is available before physical master E-stop removal is coordinated.
steps.instruction: In the live RMS / fleet status UI, open or remain on monitor/robotControl and verify that the robotControl screen finishes loading and is available for viewing.
steps.expected_result: The RMS monitor/robotControl screen is displayed and available for viewing.
steps.healthy_condition: The robotControl page loads as an operational RMS screen rather than remaining blank, unavailable, or inaccessible.
steps.failure_condition: The robotControl screen does not load, remains unavailable, or cannot be viewed.

actions.label: Inspect robotControl availability
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the RMS robot-control screen loads before the master E-stop is removed.

stop_or_escalate_if: The RMS robotControl screen does not load or is unavailable.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source instructs the user to confirm that the RMS robot-control screen loads before UPS removes the master E-stop.

steps.title: Communicate RMS screen availability
steps.purpose: Provide the site or UPS with the result needed to coordinate the next physical safety action.
steps.instruction: After the RMS robotControl screen-load check succeeds, communicate to the site or UPS that the RMS screen is available. Do not communicate approval to perform any physical action beyond reporting the screen state.
steps.expected_result: The site or UPS receives a clear report that the RMS robotControl screen is available for viewing.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen-load result is communicated as a successful RMS availability check before any physical master E-stop removal is coordinated.
steps.failure_condition: The result cannot be communicated, or the RMS screen is reported as available despite a failed or incomplete load check.

actions.label: Report RMS availability
actions.exact_action: Communicate that the RMS screen is available so the site or UPS can coordinate the physical master E-stop removal.

stop_or_escalate_if: The robotControl screen-load check has not succeeded.
The site or UPS requests remote performance of the physical master E-stop action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source instructs the user to confirm that the RMS screen loads before having UPS remove the master E-stop.

success_criteria: The live RMS / fleet status UI is reachable.
L2_support can sign in using the available RMS access.
The monitor/robotControl screen loads and is available for viewing.
The successful screen-availability result is communicated to the site or UPS before physical master E-stop removal is coordinated.
healthy_conditions: The RMS monitor/robotControl page is loaded and viewable.
The screen-load status is clearly reported to the site or UPS.
failure_conditions: The RMS / fleet status UI or robotControl path is unreachable.
RMS access is unavailable or sign-in fails.
The robotControl screen does not load or remains unavailable.
Physical master E-stop removal is requested without a successful RMS screen-load confirmation.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when the RMS robotControl screen cannot be loaded or viewed.
Escalate access or authentication issues because the source does not specify the exact administrator permissions or credentials.
The site or UPS must retain responsibility for any physical master E-stop removal or reset; L2_support must not perform that physical action.
